io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.led.LedMatrix

Packages that use LedMatrix
Package
Description
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware
The board's own hardware and program-wide introspection: ArduinoUno and ArduinoNano hand out the board's pins, I2C bus, USB mouse, LED matrix, clock, BoardModel (which board the program was compiled for) and BoardMemory (Juno's arena and the program's flash usage).
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal
The board's native implementations: the classes whose methods are compiler intrinsics.

    NativeLedMatrix
    The board's LedMatrix: each method is an LED matrix intrinsic the compiler lowers to the Arduino_LED_Matrix library, so it has no Java body and cannot run, or be mocked, on a desktop JVM.
